message.content: Get application's name along with its current version?

function.name: version_api_VersionApi_get_version
function.description: Retrieve the application's name and its current version as a JSON object. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_get_project_by_name_and_version
function.description: Retrieve the details of a project based on its name and version identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name of the project.

version.description: Semantic version number of the project, in the format 'major.minor.patch'.

function.name: ProjectApi_update_project
function.description: Updates the specified project with new information such as its name, status, and description. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to be updated.

name.description: The new name of the project.

status.description: The current status of the project.

description.description: A brief description of the project.

project_data.description: A dictionary containing the updated data for the project.

function.name: badge_api_BadgeApi_get_project_vulnerabilities_badge
function.description: Retrieves the current security metrics, such as the number of vulnerabilities, for a specified project and its version. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name of the project for which to retrieve security metrics.

version.description: The specific version of the project to query. Follows semantic versioning, e.g., '1.2.3'.

function.name: badge_api_BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge1
function.description: This function retrieves a badge image that indicates whether a specific project version complies with defined policy rules. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name of the project for which the policy violations badge is being queried.

version.description: The specific version identifier of the project to check for policy violations.
